title: Redstrike HTTP History
description: The proxy-context recon feeder's http_history.json: the connected interception proxy's captured, secret-redacted request/response exchanges, exported so the console Site Map and the executors read REAL traffic instead of re-crawling. Canonical shape is an object wrapping exchanges[]; a legacy flat array of exchanges is also accepted (the console and this schema's anyOf both normalize it). host+path+method are the Site Map merge keys; status/mime/params drive its facets; req/res carry the raw message for the viewer. Tolerant (recon export) — only the exchange shape is pinned, extra keys allowed, an empty exchanges[] is valid (no proxy was connected).

host.description: hostname (port optional) — a Site Map merge key.

method.description: HTTP verb — a Site Map merge key.

path.description: pathname (+ query when meaningful) — a Site Map merge key.

message.description: A request or response half. headers is an array of [name,value] pairs; body is the raw (redacted) message body.
